classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. The three-set example demonstrates bracket-first operations; the definitions allow comparison of elements inside and outside A.

content.prompt:
True or False? Let $A$, $B$ and $C$ be sets in a universal set $U$.

$A\cup(B\cap C)=(A\cup B)\cap(A\cup C)$.

answer.worked: True. An element in $A$ belongs to both sides. An element outside $A$ belongs to either side exactly when it is in both $B$ and $C$. Thus both sides contain the same elements.
